import CategoryTheory
import Cardinal
import CategoryTheory.CardinalAccessibility

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C]
  {κ : Cardinal.{w}} [Fact κ.IsRegular]
  [CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory C κ]
  (X : C) : CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered (CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow (CategoryTheory.isCardinalPresentable C κ).ι X) κ := by
  let ι := (CategoryTheory.isCardinalPresentable C κ).ι
  let costructured_arrow_category := CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow ι X

  letI : IsLimitPreserving ι := by apply_instance
  letI : IsColimitPreserving ι := by apply_instance

  letI : IsLeftAdjoint ι := by apply_instance
  letI : IsRightAdjoint ι := by apply_instance

  have h1 : ∀ {A B : C}, (ι A).isPresentable ∧ (ι B).isPresentable := 
    λ A B, and.intro (ι A).isPresentable (ι B).isPresentable

  have h2 : ∀ {A B : C}, CategoryTheory.IsColimitCostructuredArrow (ι A) (ι B) :=
    λ A B, by apply_instance

  have h3 : ∀ {A B : C}, CategoryTheory.IsLimitCostructuredArrow (ι A) (ι B) :=
    λ A B, by apply_instance

  have h4 : CategoryTheory.IsFiltered costructured_arrow_category :=
    by
      constructor
      intros I D f g
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.isFiltered_iff.1 (CategoryTheory.isCardinalFiltered_of_presentable _ _ _ _ _ _)
      exact hK

  have h5 : CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered costructured_arrow_category κ :=
    by
      constructor
      intros I D f g
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered.isFiltered_iff.1 (CategoryTheory.isCardinalFiltered_of_presentable _ _ _ _ _ _)
      exact hK

  exact h5
